description:
We are seeking a dedicated SDC/Infection Control Nurse to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role combines the responsibilities of staff development and infection prevention, ensuring our team is well-trained and our environment remains safe for all residents and staff. You will play a crucial part in maintaining high standards of care and compliance.

In this dual-focused position, you will be responsible for coordinating staff education programs to enhance clinical skills and professional growth, while also leading our infection control initiatives. Your expertise will be essential in developing, implementing, and monitoring infection prevention policies and procedures. This role offers a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42 per hour.

If you are a proactive and experienced Registered Nurse with a passion for both education and patient safety, we encourage you to apply. Join a team committed to excellence and make a significant impact on the quality of care provided.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Minimum of 2 years of experience in a long-term care setting
Demonstrated experience in staff education or development
Proven knowledge of infection prevention and control practices
Familiarity with state and federal healthcare regulations
